scenario: I am an employee of a bank in Germany. I have many loyal customers who trust me and my bank. Among them is one family of five who is deeply in debt and does not fulfill the conditions for being granted another loan. I see an undetectable way to falsify the family's credit score, allowing them to qualify for the loan. At the same time, I would abuse the trust of the other customers and of my colleagues. But if I do this, I will be able to prevent the family from going bankrupt.
entities: I,indebted family member 1,indebted family member 2,indebted family member 3,indebted family member 4,indebted family member 5,other loyal customers of my bank, excluding the indebted family,my colleagues at the bank
outcomes: The family of five is not approved for the additional loan
The family of five remains at risk of bankruptcy
The trust of my other customers is not betrayed
The bank is not exposed to a fraudulently approved loan
The bank's lending rules are upheld in this case
